blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) on Thursday said it was still verifying reports of a Filipino’s death in a drone attack in Saudi Arabia. This follows international reports, citing Saudi Arabia’s Energy Ministry, that debris from an intercepted drone killed a Filipino and a Nepali national and injured a Pakistani and an Indian national. “Nakatanggap ang Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) ng mga ulat hinggil sa pagkasawi umano ng isang Pilipino sa isang pag atake sa Saudi Arabia,” OWWA Admin PY Caunan told reporters in a text message.
